<Canvas>
<Mark target="notebook" shape="underline" u={0.5} v={0.4} w={0.75}/>
<Panel id="steps" near="notebook" side="right" w={560}>
<Heading>Ball thrown up at 20 m/s</Heading>
<Steps>
<Step><Text>At the top, velocity is zero.</Text><Math>v = v_0 - g t = 0</Math></Step>
<Step><Text>Time to the top.</Text><Math>t = v_0 / g = 20 / 9.8 = 2.04\ \text{s}</Math></Step>
<Step><Text>Height from the average velocity.</Text><Math>h = v_0^2 / (2g) = 400 / 19.6 = 20.4\ \text{m}</Math></Step>
<Step><Text>Down and up take the same time.</Text><Math>T = 2 v_0 / g = 4.08\ \text{s}</Math></Step>
<Step highlight><Text>Answers.</Text><Math>h = 20.4\ \text{m},\quad T = 4.08\ \text{s}</Math></Step>
</Steps>
<Note kind="tip">Pick up = positive, g = 9.8 m/s² down.</Note>
</Panel>
<Panel id="graph" x={620} y={640} w={560}>
<Plot fn="20*x - 4.9*x^2" xmin={0} xmax={4.1} ymin={0} ymax={22} points="2.04,20.4" label="height vs time"/>
</Panel>
<Arrow from="#graph" to="notebook@0.9,0.85"/>
</Canvas>
